title: The Jordas Verdict/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: - Lotus: "Something in the air is corroding your Warframe. Limit your exposure."
- Ordis: "Operator, are you really going to touch that thing?"
- Jordas: "I don't recommend touching that Operator."
- Lotus: "This debris could prove tactically useful."
- Lotus: "Can you use this to your advantage?"
- Jordas: "Embrace us. We are your flesh."
